svg.title: mooncake_store: one Mooncake Store pool shared across nodes and P/D instances
svg.desc: Prefill PP stages put and get 256-token KV chunks straight between HBM and DRAM segments that owners on the prefill node, the decode node and other instances mount on the Store masters.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: One Mooncake Store pool, shared across nodes and P/D instances

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: ATOM mooncake_store offload: prefill PP stages put and get 256-token KV chunks straight between HBM and pooled DRAM over GPUDirect RDMA. No LMCache in the middle.
